name: baml-pipelines-mcp
description: Compiled MCP server that exposes registered BAML pipelines as a single high-context MCP tool surface

documentation.quickstart: Start server: node modules/baml-pipelines-mcp/dist/server.js. Requires BAML_PIPELINES_REGISTRY_PATH and BAML_MODULE_ROOT env vars.
documentation.integration: Wraps baml-openrouter pipelines as MCP tools; configure in your IDE's MCP settings
